# MLDawn Academy

> MLDawn Academy is an AI and machine learning education platform offering hands-on courses in deep learning, data science, and medical imaging applications.

MLDawn Academy provides practical, project-based learning in machine learning and artificial intelligence, with a focus on real-world applications like brain tumor detection using medical imaging. The platform is based in Bali and serves students globally through its comprehensive course catalog and interactive learning dashboard.

## Key Topics

- Machine Learning
- Deep Learning
- Artificial Intelligence
- Data Science
- Brain Tumor Detection
- Medical Imaging
- MRI Analysis
- Hands-on Projects
- Career Pathways
- Content Marketing
- Course Catalog
- User Authentication
- AI Courses
